title: The Grief She Bears Alone
note: She says the overflowing grief is hers alone and not his, because he left for righteousness and wealth. It belongs to the woman who has suffered pallor.

couplets.plain: Those whose love is returned by the one they love have found the stoneless fruit of desire.
couplets.pm: Women loved by the husbands they love have surely received the stoneless fruit, the enjoyment of desire. They have received it, because it can’t be had without good deeds done before. It is stoneless, because nothing hinders it. Our lover has left and won’t return, so we haven’t received that fruit.
couplets.context: Her friend says he can bear this even less than she can, so he will soon come, and she will have great joy with him. She answers.
couplets.speaker: she

links.quote: Those whose love is returned by the one they love
links.reason: Desire tastes wholly sweet only to those whose love is returned.

couplets.plain: The kindness of lovers to those who love them is like rain from the sky to those who live by it.
couplets.pm: When men leave for righteousness and wealth, husbands who can’t do without their wives come back in due measure and show them tenderness. This is like the sky raining in due measure on those who live by it. Our lover doesn’t want us, so we have no such tenderness. Like those who live by rain in a drought, we can only die.
couplets.context: She goes on, answering her friend.
couplets.speaker: she

links.quote: like rain from the sky to those who live by it
links.reason: A lover’s kindness sustains the one who loves, as rain sustains those who live by it.

couplets.plain: Only those loved by the ones they love can have the pride of saying, “We will live.”
couplets.pm: Women wanted by the husbands they want may well have this proud thought: though he has left, he will think of us and soon come, and then we will live in joy. He doesn’t want us, so what suits us is death.
couplets.context: She goes on, answering her friend.
couplets.speaker: she

links.quote: Only those loved by the ones they love can have the pride

couplets.plain: Even those who are held dear are without blessing, if the one they love doesn’t love them back.
couplets.pm: Even women honoured by chaste women are sinners, if the husbands they love don’t love them. Having no good deeds means having evil ones. Such honour is no use to me, with my evil deeds.
couplets.context: Her friend says that by hiding his lack of compassion she shows a god-like chastity and will be honoured by chaste women. She answers.
couplets.speaker: she
couplets.sensitive: tells an unloved woman she can have no happiness at all

links.quote: if the one they love doesn’t love them back
links.reason: Being held dear by others counts for nothing beside the one love she lacks.

couplets.plain: What can the one I love do for me, if he doesn’t love me too?
couplets.pm: What joy can the one we love give us, if he doesn’t love us as we love him? All our love has brought us is pain.
couplets.context: Her friend says that because she loves him she has understood his purpose and borne up. She answers.
couplets.speaker: she

links.quote: if he doesn’t love me too
What can the one I love do for me

couplets.plain: Desire on one side only is painful. Like the load on a carrying pole, it is sweet when it is on both sides.
couplets.pm: When longing is on one side only, the woman’s or the man’s, it is painful. When it is equal on both sides, like the loads on a carrying pole, it is sweet. If the longing in me were in him too, would I suffer like this?
couplets.context: She goes on, answering her friend.
couplets.speaker: she

links.quote: Desire on one side only is painful
it is sweet when it is on both sides

couplets.plain: The god of desire stays on one side only. Doesn’t he see my pain and my grief?
couplets.pm: The god of desire should stand equally with both lovers, yet he stands with one and attacks her. Doesn’t he know the pain of her pallor and the flood of her grief? Even a god, who without liking or dislike should know all that happens in everyone, has turned against me. How can I escape now?
couplets.context: She goes on, answering her friend.
couplets.speaker: she

links.reason: The god of desire stays on one side only, leaving her to suffer alone.

couplets.plain: No one in the world is as hard as those who go on living without a sweet word from the one they love.
couplets.pm: No one in the world is as hard as women who bear parting and stay alive without even one sweet word about the lover they want. She says “sweet word” because any word about him would be sweet to her. I am hard, for I live on without even that.
couplets.context: No messenger comes from him, and she says this.
couplets.speaker: she
couplets.sensitive: calls women who go on living without his love hard-hearted, implying they should not

couplets.plain: Even if the one I long for isn’t kind to me, any word of him is sweet to my ears.
couplets.pm: Though the lover I long for has no loving-kindness towards me, any word about him is sweet to my ears. Even the word that he isn’t coming would do. I haven’t had even that.
couplets.context: She goes on, with still no messenger from him.
couplets.speaker: she
couplets.sensitive: finds any word from an unkind partner sweet, which could hold someone in a harmful bond

links.quote: any word of him is sweet to my ears

couplets.plain: Long may you live, my heart. You would tell your sickness to one who isn’t close to you. Fill in the sea instead.
couplets.pm: Heart, you are about to tell your sickness to one who is nothing to you. If you can’t bear it, drop that hard task and try filling in the sea that torments you, which is easy. The sickness is past telling and the listener is no kin, so it can’t work, and would do no good if it did. So she says “long may you live” in mockery.
couplets.context: No messenger comes from him. Thinking of sending one herself, she says this to her heart.
couplets.speaker: she

links.quote: Long may you live, my heart

links.reason: Filling in the sea would be easier than this telling.

links.quote: You would tell your sickness to one who isn’t close to you
